method: Built-in image_gen for empty scenery only; original supplied character overlays composed with Pillow
backgroundPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an EMPTY SCENERY PLATE for the happy surprise reveal in a glossy 3D chibi children's fairy-tale comic: Aurora has built a spectacular NEW PLAYGROUND outside her sky castle among fluffy white clouds. Bright welcoming daytime, pastel rainbow colours, ivory pearl and gold castle architecture in the distance, sunny blue sky. Main focus is an inventive delightful playground spread across a wide floating cloud garden: big rainbow twisting slide attached to a small turret playhouse, gold star-framed swings with pink shell seats, a pastel roundabout, cloud-shaped trampolines, rainbow stepping-stones and a climbing net bridge connecting two little pastel towers. Pretty flower borders, pearl railings, toy-like rounded shapes, polished soft materials, magical sparkles and a few pastel pennant strings without writing. Child-friendly happy surprise, nothing sinister. Wide 16:9 scene, play structures clearly visible in upper two-thirds, a broad simple pale lavender plaza spanning bottom third deliberately empty for compositing five original character images later. Camera sees whole playground in inviting three-quarter perspective with depth, composition not overcrowded. Absolutely NO people, NO characters, NO creatures, NO faces, NO silhouettes or statues; scenery only. No text, captions, labels, letters, logos, watermark or frame.
storyIntent: Nothing bad is happening. Aurora Ping has finished her new playground and could not wait to invite all her friends to see it.
presentation: Wordless reveal from the arriving friends' viewpoint, with Aurora and the four formerly shadowed visitors in their original colours.
